title: TikTok Adds an AI Shopping Assistant and One-Click Buying
key_facts: TikTok announced Buy Direct and Shopping Assistant on 5 Oct 2026 at Advertising Week New York.
Buy Direct: one-click checkout in the For You feed, separate from TikTok Shop, using stored payment methods and addresses.
Shopping Assistant: conversational agent for product details, shipping, sizing, availability.
Built with commerce and payment partners including Salesforce, Shopify, Shoplazza and Stripe; part of a programme called Agentic Commerce.
Stores need Universal Commerce Protocol support.
Reports differ on whether features are live in the US or still in testing.
Commission terms and non-US timing are unspecified.
quote_evidence: On October 5, 2026, the company announced an upgraded checkout option, enabling users to make purchases from brands within the application
Several details are up in the air.
why_it_matters_hint: Social platforms want to keep AI shopping inside their own apps.
notes: Older news re-dated: ALM Corp published its summary on 15 Oct about a 5 Oct announcement; secondary roundup of other outlets' reports, TikTok's own materials not read.
